items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Adolph Alexander. He played with you? [INTERVIEWEE] He played, yeah.

ctx.x: Buddy Johnson's brother. He was playing.
Oh, both of them. Yank. Yank. Yank was his name. Let's see. And, forget who. Vic Gasper. Buddy Adolph Alexander.
Vic Gasper. He was playing baritone and slide. He's dead. Yes.
